sources.name: PocketDecks legacy v4
sources.scope: Print inventory, artwork URL metadata, set/collector identity, rarity, name, HP and elemental/category summary. Entire legacy JSON bundled verbatim. v5 and its projections/expansions are excluded.

sources.name: flibustier print and set metadata
sources.scope: Full basic print and release metadata bundled verbatim. Internal card-design identity derived from asset filenames. cards.extra.json not imported: inspected combat defaults are unreliable and it contains no attacks.

sources.name: TCGdex main Pocket mechanics
sources.scope: English values extracted from 2,480 card data literals and 15 set data literals. Only data fields retained; each card retains sourcePath/sourceSha256. No source/application code or images bundled.

sources.name: TCGdex pending Deluxe Pack ex data
sources.scope: English values extracted from 288 card data literals. Partial branch export; gaps filled only by verified asset identity to known MIT rules. No source/application code or images bundled.

sources.name: Vociferix Pocket detailed mechanics supplement
sources.usage: Exact missing prints only: 1140 records /631 previously unknown identities. Reviewed TCGdex unchanged.

policy: No PocketDecks v5 cards/gameplay/collection/expansions or third-party application code incorporated. Existing LuckyDex collection feed is unchanged by this acquisition task. MIT notices must accompany redistribution. Artwork/trademarks remain with their owners.
